purpose: Review official Florence/Italian cadastral channels and qualify bounded anonymous parcel geometry evidence.
assessment: The official Comune di Firenze SIGS viewer is a local public cadastral map custodian and exposes a Catasto parcel layer. Its current configuration was inspected, but the configured proxy route did not produce a usable feature/schema response. No geometry sample is retained.
registryAssessment: Local registry/map custodian evidenced: Comune di Firenze SIGS. National metadata custodian/contact evidenced separately through RNDT/Agenzia delle Entrate. This does not establish citywide downloadable coverage or title-record access.

attempts: Fetched official SIGS viewer anonymously; HTTP 200; inspected current inline JavaScript configuration.

Attempted anonymous TLS-verified WMS GetCapabilities through the configured proxy; proxy returned a routing/missing-request ServiceException and no capabilities.
Attempted anonymous TLS-verified bounded GetMap request for the parcel layer around the unchanged WUP point; no usable parcel image/feature response was obtained.
Fetched RNDT Florence cadastral metadata anonymously; recorded metadata evidence only, with no owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, or personal fields requested or retained.
No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, TLS exception, or synthetic identity was used.
